    • ITI104_PATIENT_IDENTIFIER_HEADER

      static final String ITI104_PATIENT_IDENTIFIER_HEADER
      Name of the Camel header by which a Patient Identity Source may state the identifier of the conditional update or delete, either as Identifier or as system|value token. If missing, the identifier is taken from the message body.
